neighbours.label: ' been' in the present perfect progressive ('have been / 've been' + -ing)
fire: Lately we have been planting tomatoes in the back garden.
My sister has been learning Spanish for about two years.
The kids have been building a treehouse all summer.
I've been reading a great book about the history of maps.
This month our class has been studying volcanoes and earthquakes.
They've been working on the new bridge since March.
We have been testing a new recipe for sourdough bread.
For weeks he has been practicing the piano every evening.
quiet: Last spring we planted tomatoes in the back garden.
My sister learned Spanish in about two years.
The kids built a treehouse last summer.
I read a great book about the history of maps.
This month our class will study volcanoes and earthquakes.
They started work on the new bridge in March.
We tested a new recipe for sourdough bread.
For weeks he practiced the piano every evening.
